features.name: Altar
features.description: An ornamental place of ritual worship, such as a raised stone dais or consecrated slab.

features.name: Animal Pen
features.description: An enclosure or indoor dwelling designed for one or more animals or a familiar.

features.name: Antechamber
features.description: A separate enclosed compartment or vestibule, allowing spells to be cast in a secure, isolated space.

features.name: Astronomical Device
features.description: Sophisticated observational instruments, such as an astrolabe or armillary sphere, placed near a window or skylight.

features.name: Balance
features.description: An exact weighing device, such as a set of brass scales or delicate balances.

features.name: Balcony
features.description: An outdoor platform or parapet allowing direct casting into the open air.

features.name: Cage
features.description: A large cage built of sturdy iron or steel bars for imprisoning, holding, or immobilizing subjects.

features.name: Cauldron
features.description: A heavy copper, bronze, or brass cauldron for heating and mixing massive quantities of compounds.

features.name: Desk
features.description: A comfortable, stout writing table designed specifically for reading, research, and scribing.

features.name: Fireplace
features.description: A stone hearth or fireplace where fuel is burned for heat, incineration, or thermal processing.

features.name: Forge
features.description: A robust furnace operated by bellows, complete with anvil and smithy tools for smelting and metalwork.

features.name: Grave
features.description: The burial site of one or more corpses, ranging from an earthen pit to an ornate stone sarcophagus.

features.name: Lofty Ceiling
features.description: A tall, airy overhead space, often featuring vaulted arches or high rafters.

features.name: Loom
features.description: A large wooden apparatus constructed for weaving threads, tapestries, and fabrics.

features.name: Map
features.description: An elaborate, highly detailed chart, plan, or relief model depicting surrounding lands, covenant grounds, or structures.

features.name: Mechanism
features.description: A complex mechanical construct with interlocking cogs, wheels, and counterweights for automating lab tasks.

features.name: Mirror
features.description: A grand, ornamental silvered mirror or polished reflective basin.

features.name: Monolith
features.description: A massive slab or pillar of primal rock, frequently inscribed with mystical runes or sigils.

features.name: Orb
features.description: A smooth, polished sphere of crystal or precious stone used in scrying and divinatory workings.

features.name: Pallet
features.description: An examination table or bed equipped for medical treatment, surgery, or physiological study.

features.name: Pit
features.description: A deep hole dug directly into the chamber floor to contain or isolate dangerous substances/creatures.

features.name: Pool
features.description: A still body of water, basin, or subterranean well utilized for scrying and fluid manipulation.

features.name: Portal
features.description: A formal gateway or archway constructed to summon, evoke, or transport entities and energies.

features.name: Rack
features.description: A mechanical torture device or restraint frame for binding and straining human or animal bodies.

features.name: Running Water
features.description: A continuous stream, channel, conduit, or fountain flowing through or around the lab.

features.name: Statue
features.description: A carved stone, metal, or porcelain semblance of a person, mythical creature, or symbolic figure.

features.name: Still
features.description: A complex network of glass or metal tubing connecting delicate retorts and alembics for distillation.

features.name: Summoning Circle
features.description: An elaborate pentagram or warding diagram permanently etched or inlaid upon the floor.

features.name: Tablet
features.description: A large, framed slab of wax or slate designed for temporary scribing and diagramming with a stylus.

features.name: Tank
features.description: A heavy, bulky vat or container for storing large volumes of liquid or organic samples.

features.name: Throne
features.description: An opulent, elevated seat intended for a ruler, master, or instructor to sit in state.

features.name: Tree
features.description: A living tree, sapling, or sprawling vine growing inside the laboratory space.

features.name: Void
features.description: A shaft, opening, or chasm descending into darkness or leading outdoors.

features.name: Wall
features.description: A broad, smooth blank wall utilized for projecting illusions or summoning visual phantasms.

features.name: Wheel
features.description: A large wheel powered by water, wind, animals, laborers, or magic.

features.name: Window
features.description: An opening or skylight giving direct exposure to the sun, moon, stars, and weather.

features.name: Fumes
features.description: A glass sphere on a plinth, holding swirling noxious vapours taken from a volcanic vent (Hermetic Projects p. 26).

features.name: Pool of Lava
features.description: The lab encloses a pool of lava, or a cauldron keeps a sample of it molten (Hermetic Projects p. 26).

features.name: Thermal Spring
features.description: A volcanically heated spring bubbles up in the middle of the lab (Hermetic Projects p. 27).

features.name: Volcanic Rock
features.description: A huge slab of volcanic rock lies at the lab's centre (Hermetic Projects p. 27).
